At some point before [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] hired the services of a '''xenobiologist''' to work as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and discover the [[Taurill Overmind|hive mind]] of the [[Taurill/Legends|Taurill]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. After selling the information to Durga, the [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] was killed to protect the secret.
